answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a zephyr bet on surviving 61 epochs of grading, and every island settlement recomputes the horizon schedule, so an hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 61 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
